items.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
items.synopsis: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence.

items.title: Arcane: League of Legends
items.synopsis: Set in the utopian region of Piltover and the oppressed underground of Zaun, the story follows the origins of two iconic League champions-and the power that will tear them apart.

items.title: Inside Out 2
items.synopsis: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust are managing a successful operation by all accounts until Anxiety shows up with an all-new crew of emotions.

items.title: Despicable Me 4
items.synopsis: Gru, Lucy, Margo, Edith, and Agnes welcome a new member to the family, Gru Jr., who is intent on tormenting his dad. A new nemesis emerges, forcing the family into hiding.
